title: Keep numerical discovery and exact comparison certificates separate
statement: The preserved first adaptive small-Q run stopped with a solver failure after its Q1/Q2 outputs. The source was then changed before the later parallel and Q3 adaptive runs. Exact displayed add/patch text and selected failed/numerical outputs retain their native versions, warnings and constraint residuals. These are discovery diagnostics rather than exact optima, general query lower bounds, source execution or device evidence; later exact dual/controller certificates have their own distinct scope.
